The main takeaway from our work is that

enforcing a trust region constraint on joint policies is crucial for optimizing decentralized policies under non-stationarity, and that this can be achieved in a principled manner by bounding independent ratios via clipping.

, in order to ensure monotonic improvement, it is not enough for a policy gradient method to satisfy the standard trust region constraint, which only enforces monotonic improvement for stationary transition dynamics.
